dedupe_keys.name: co udlabs wp6 t61 insa 001 pah probe testing data sets

description: Lepot, Mathieu at insa lyon publishes stormwater PAH-probe observations and laboratory comparison data through Co-UDlabs. Nine samples from 2023 compare the probe with laboratory PAH analysis. A 155,155-value two-minute 2022 series includes rainfall, pump state, discharge, conductivity and turbidity with stated uncertainty fields. A companion version replaces stagnant-water intervals with NaN when the feeding pump is off. Coverage is Chassieu stormwater outlet, Lyon, from 30 May to 31 December 2022, plus 2023 comparison samples. Zenodo provides CSV components in a ZIP and a PDF description with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is stagnant-water values are not representative of sewer flow, and related source reporting warns that the PAH sensor did not reliably measure pollutants. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
